decisions.reason: The main board is referenced only as the precedent for applying the same mechanical adjustment to the sensor board; its existing layout state is not changed.
The source request concerns bottom connectors on the sensor board and does not change the power board layout.
The sensor-board connector repositioning does not affect the battery connector on the power board.
Moving and reorienting sensor-board connectors does not change the interboard topology, connector types, designations, or pinouts.
The mechanical relocation does not change the required sensor connector inventory, connector count, types, or pin assignments.
Sensor-board connector placement and orientation do not alter rail-monitoring coverage, channels, or hardware.
The connector movement does not change the requirement to hardwire the SPS30 SEL pin to ground for I2C mode.
The mechanical connector adjustment does not change sensor logic voltages or the decision to omit on-board level shifting.
The source concerns sensor-board connectors, not the main-board panel power-button connector.
Repositioning sensor-board connectors does not change standalone USB power capacity, source selection, or powered loads.
The source changes connector mechanics only and does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, or bus speed.
The sensor-board connector adjustment is unrelated to the main-board BOOT and reset circuit.
